{{Quote|Captain Herc here. You're all clear, Commander.|Herc to Bant Eerin's Padawan|<ref name="Way of the Jedi" />}}
'''Herc''' was a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] [[Clone Captain/Legends|captain]] in command of the [[Eighteenth Battalion]] under [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bant Eerin/Legends|Bant Eerin]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He led his forces, together with [[Bant Eerin's Padawan|Eerin's Padawan]], on the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] moon [[Akoshissss]] against the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] in the [[Battle of Akoshissss]].<ref name="Way of the Jedi" />
